result.summary: The page is a food-delivery home screen that mostly renders correctly, but there are a few visual defects: a stray horizontal line crossing the bottom navigation bar, truncated text on the horizontally-scrolling restaurant card, a partially rendered category chip, and the second 'Popular right now' card missing its title/metadata.

issues.description: A thick black horizontal line stretches across the bottom navigation bar, overlapping the search and orders icons. It looks like a rendering artifact or misplaced divider rather than an intentional element.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the stray line/divider element; ensure the bottom nav icons render cleanly without overlapping graphics.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' shows truncated text 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, and the card itself is clipped at the screen edge without clear affordance that it continues.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccol…') and ensure the carousel peek is intentional with consistent spacing to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: A category filter chip at the far right (after 'Healthy') is cut off, showing only an empty sliver with no readable label.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip carousel padding or peek amount so partially visible chips still show enough of their label to hint at scrollable content.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza with −20% badge) has no restaurant name, rating, or delivery info visible below the image, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it.
issues.suggestion: If the metadata is merely cut off by the viewport this may be acceptable, but verify the card renders its title and details; otherwise add the missing restaurant info for consistency.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons have no text labels, and the current tab is only indicated by icon color, which may be hard to distinguish.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each nav icon and ensure the active state uses more than color alone (e.g., filled icon plus label).

issues.description: Delivery time badges on 'Fastest near you' cards sit inconsistently within the images (varying vertical alignment across cards).
issues.suggestion: Standardize the badge position (e.g., consistent bottom-left offset) across all cards for a tidier grid.
